## GET `/api/2.29/rapid-data-locking`

**Tier:** T0  

Displays the status of the Rapid Data Locking feature.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `RapidDataLockingResponse`

## PATCH `/api/2.29/rapid-data-locking`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies the Rapid Data Locking feature. Note that the feature can only be enabled if there are no file systems nor buckets created on the array. Once enabled, the feature cannot be modified.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

**Request body** (required): `RapidDataLocking`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `True` if the Rapid Data Locking feature is enabled. |
| `kmip_server` | `_reference` | The KMIP server configuration associated with RDL. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `RapidDataLockingResponse`
